intro: See how your online shop is doing, and where your forms lose people. Open a shop from Sales channels and choose its Performance tab.
start: Open your online shop and choose Performance, then Forms.
Pick the days and, if you want, one kind of device at the top.

articles.title: Find where a form loses people
articles.summary: See how many started a form, how many sent it, and the step and field where the rest left.
before: Your shop needs to count visits. If it does not, Performance says so and offers to turn it on.

steps.rest: on your online shop and choose Forms.
Each form shows how many started, how many were sent, how many left and the usual time a sent one took. Turn Compare on to see the days before.
A drawer opens with its steps and its fields.
on the steps, then sort the fields by Left here, Time, Corrections or Errors.

articles.after: A form that shows an error often, or that most people leave at one field, is the one to change first. Press Refresh to read the figures again.
tips: A contact form is named by the title of its block on your page.
A day marked incomplete lost some counts, so its figures may be low.

articles.title: Count a sent form in your own funnel
articles.summary: Add a form that was sent as a step of a funnel, to see how many visitors get there.

steps.rest: on the Performance overview and press New funnel.
for a step and pick the form from the list.
Its steps are counted from then on.
